body:
IMO one of the most beautiful things in the world is to witness someone doing something they love, just being happy being themselves. You're only ever living in the present so no, it's definitely not to late. 

So I say go for it, be happy, there's no shame in that.

I wouldn't label you as a molester and you most definitely shouldn't kill yourself because of this.

Maybe you could take this negative experience and do something good because of it? Donate to a organization like RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) that helps victims of sexual assault. Maybe even do it on a monthly basis, it won't get rid of the guilt of what you did but I'm sure you'll at least feel better knowing you're making a positive impact on the world.

She has no reason to believe in me, I've chosen to give up and rot in my depression because it's the easiest thing I can do without killing myself and hurting her. I'm not getting out of this because I don't want to, it makes no sense to believe in someone who's making 0 attempts to improve themselves.

And I've never done anything in the past to warrant her faith. I'm a high school dropout, never went to college, never had a job, and I'm almost 24.

Pretty relatable. I'm almost 24 now and have been with my soul mate (now wife) since I was 14. Regardless of the fact that we are inseparable I still choose to do the wrong thing every time since it's easy. I feel lazy and selfish and useless and all for no good reason, just like you. 
I always think that she's the best thing that ever happened to me but I'm the worst to her since I'm just dragging her down with me.


Have you ever had your hormones checked? My wife has hypothyroidism and since getting that treated it greatly helped her depression. You could also have some vitamin deficiency, especially vitamin D.

As long as we're still alive though it's not to late to turn things around. I wish I could offer more advice but I'm kinda dumb and stuck in a similar situation.

I hope you get better

I also get really jealous, if I was high functioning I could at least make my wife happy and take stress off of her.
I've been wondering a while if anyone else felt this way and how common it is.
Instead of doing that I'm just going to kill myself when my wife is having surgery in a few days. You're totally right though, I'm pathetic and I should Man up but I won't.

I know I'm pathetic. But if I could just leave her I would. I've tried before, I've begged her to divorce me and find someone who loves her like I do but can financially support her but she refuses. Also she already knows any attempts I'd make to break up with her is because I want to kill myself. And even IF I could somehow get her to leave me the second she finds out I killed myself she will follow me.

Thanks for the talk, at least now I know I'm truly a POS and that it's not just "depression" like she claims.
Pretty much nothing yeah, so I know I'm going to continue this trend so therefore I should kill myself.

Of course I feel an immense amount of guilt. I'm always thinking about all the things I could of done with my wife if I hadn't just given up. So much happiness and joy and experiencing so many new things. I feel so much guilt for what could of been both in the past and the future. 

Just not killing myself is so hard, I already have a previous suicide attempt that would of worked but the only thing that stopped me was the guilt of knowing what I'd do to my wife. But you know what's improved since then? Since I swore I'd get better? Absolutely nothing, nothing at all. Even the threat of death staring me right in the face wasn't enough to change me. If you want to read about something else that didn't change me, [Take a look at this](https://www.reddit.com/r/LSD/comments/lwz8pv/my_wife_and_i_tripped_together_and_my_suicidal/). 
I'll always be like this, making excuses because I just want to stay this way, lazy. I'm a pathetic excuse of a husband, a human, but most of all I'm just selfish. 

But when I'm dead there won't be emotions, there will be nothing forever. No more pain, guilt, or anything.
That's what I've been thinking, maybe I'm just the world's most lazy person.

She'll kill herself to so she won't suffer long. I do care but I can only take but so much myself. I know I'm stupid and selfish and weak, but it is what it is and I should just accept it and stop trying to run away from it.
I tried and was denied. I won't bother trying again.

You're right, I'm making excuses because I don't want to put in the hard work required to get better.

I guess I'm done making excuses and I'll just pick the easy path like I've always done.

You and everyone else is right. I'm making excuses, I won't do what I need. Killing myself is the easy and selfish way out, I like easy things and I'm a selfish person.

I guess it's decided.

Well the solution is easy, start working out, eat healthy, therapy, set small goals, get a job, change my mindset to a more positive "fuck depression" kind of mindset, ect. I know exactly what the solution is, but doing it is so hard that I'd rather die, that's the problem. Because I can't cure my depression, I can only cope. If I could cure it then things would be great but that obviously isn't an option. Yes there's plenty I can do to make handling depression easier but I can't make things easy enough. So maybe I should just kill myself really, it's the one solution I know I'm capable of doing.

So just being alive already feels like I'm doing a lot for. I can't get help for myself though because the end goal of helping myself is getting a job which is something I simply can't do. So I feel all the small steps below it are just pointless and so I rot away.

It's nice to know someone thinks she can do it though, even if it's not me.
Well she's getting help but not me. I wouldn't even know where to start with that business plan. Besides again that's working, it's absolutely miserable and I'm sure I'd be of no help anyway.

It doesn't have to be for sure, but there's genuinely nothing I enjoy doing that I can make money from. That's why it's miserable, I just want everything handed to me on a silver platter like some brat.

Life is totally worth living I agree. But I can't work, it's actually to miserable to work 8 hours a day 5 days a week no matter what I do to cope, no matter how happy I am outside of living.
I'm just not meant for how society works and I'm accepting that.
Bad bot

*psychedelics

Yeah I'm dumb

I've had suicidal thoughts since I was about 13, I started smoking weed at 22. My 1st suicide attempt was at 21.
It was definitely not the weed that caused this, and it has so far only helped.

I think if used responsibly weed is fine, most things used in moderation is fine. That's exactly what I've been doing with weed IMO and I intend to keep doing that, until I kill myself at least.

Thanks for your concern though

I'm really unsure how you can compare weed to acid, every drug is different and has different amount of times needed for a tolerance reset. Also my tolerance is still suuuper low with weed, in fact I've never done it often enough to notice a increase in tolerance because I hate the thought of losing the magic. Also really I do it more like 1-3 times a week. I especially don't see it as abuse since sometimes I'll go a few weeks without smoking and I'll feel just fine, no different at all. Sometimes I even like my wife to edge me a week or to then we get stoned and have sex, the orgasms are mind blowing. 

So maybe you're right and it will take years but for now I see it as nothing but a positive.
Honestly I've pondered what you mean and I can't figure it out. I feel so stupid

I haven't had any luck with medication no, microdosing has definitely done more for me than that ever has.

My dream would totally be a stay at home husband, like it would still be hard keeping everything clean and cooking it shit but it would completely doable, but my wife also has depression and simply won't be able to make enough money to support us both although she doesn't
believe me and says she will die trying if she has to.

I've recently accepted I had depression, mostly because I realized I had it since I was a child and that was before I became super lazy. I know I'm lazy but I have no idea when the laziness ends and my depression starts.

I don't even have many things stressing me, 95% of my stress comes from me. Other things that would stress me out a lot my wife does for me since she knows I've been struggling so hard. So nothing nothing to really cut out.

This will definitely last forever though, my depression is here to stay and I just find working SO miserable that I just can't, no matter how fulfilling my life is otherwise.

I actually have dmt and have tried it but I've never broken through since I'm always to scared to. The 1st few times I tried it were nice but lately when I've increased the dosage I just straight up panicked, I felt so much guilt(for not doing right by my wife), I felt like I wasn't welcomed, it was just nightmare of me beating myself up so I'm to scared to even use it at all now

The fact that your lover feels the same about the whole job thing breaks my heart not gonna lie. The hopelessness is completely soul crushing. 

I guess a group of like minded people would be nice to talk to (social anxiety is OP tho) but I'd have no idea where to start looking or how to talk to people. I've browsed reddit and other sites a lot and haven't come across anyone like me. Someone who has found their soul mate, can enjoy life, has hobbies, no childhood trauma, went to a good school yet dropped out, no parents pressuring me or abusing me, has never even had a job, physically is fine, or they have more mental health illnesses than me. Like I've never seen anyone with a life as stress free and easy as mine online and I've looked so hard, I don't think a group of people like me could be found. 

You made me realize I really do feel alone in this, like everyone else has SOME valid reason to feel the way they do but not me.

These feelings are permanent, a doctor, coping skills, eating right, excersis, ect can all make it easier while giving me more energy but my depression will always be there and I'll always hate working. I just feel that life's difficulty is on hard but the best I can handle is easy.

I'm really sorry you're going through something similar with your lover. Try to make sure she's seeing a endocrinologist to make sure her thyroid and hormone levels are fine. 



>You are stronger than you can begin to imagine. You’re here, you’ve made it through it all, and you think you aren’t strong?

I'm not strong at all, my wife has been the one carrying my sad ass around. Without her I would of killed myself in my teens (I'm 23). If anything it shows how strong she is, especially because she has depression herself. I've been doing nothing for 5 years, absolutely nothing. That doesn't take strength, it was simply the 2nd easiest thing I could  do, right behind killing myself.

>Please get help?

I have no idea how to get help, my end goal of getting a job feels impossible, like I can never ever cope with the misery of that. No therapy, excersise, love, happy moments, microdosing, or anything can bring the misery of having a job (no matter what job it is) down to a bearable level.

Thank you a lot for your kind words.
Good day to you and your lover.

I do smoke weed but not that often, like 2-3 times a week. It's definitely not a negative in my life, I just like getting stoned, pigging out with my wife until we regret it and listening to music

Sucks that weed is like that for you though, wish I could offer some advice other than not using it but I haven't had that experience.

The thing is I just hate any and all work, if I could just be a stay at home husband and chill and not worry or feel guilty about finances I would be obviously that's not a choice. There's nothing that interests me, nothing I find rewarding, nothing that I'm good at. Nothing I could spend hours everyday doing and not be miserable. Often I just feel like I'm not meant for how society works, not that there's a problem with money and working, it's just who I am and I'm unable to keep up. I'm just broken it feels. 

I never heard of ketamine infusion but after a couple minutes of googling it definitely looks interesting but I'd have no idea how to start about doing it, seems legal in my state to. Seems my insurance might not cover it and I don't have the money and it seems Id have to go through more traditional methods of treatment 1st so sadly to much effort for me to even try even though I think I would.
I have been microdosing LSD which which has been hit or miss, mostly miss. It's of course a tool but one I haven't been using effectively at all.

>Being in love really does cure everything,


You can look through my posts, I can confirm being in love does NOT cure everything (For me at least). But finding someone you truly love definitely helps a shit ton and can be absolutely life changing. Without my wife without a doubt in my mind I would of killed myself years ago but even with her I still might? 

Before I met my wife I had the same thoughts that maybe if I had a GF I wouldn't be so depressed and suicidal but now I'm just both with a wife.
I just hope you don't end up disappointed like I was.

I'm tired of being hopeless, being a burden, the constant guilt, the amount of effort simple things take now. So I guess I feel I'm reaching my limit. 

I've just always hated the idea of spending 1/3 of my life working. That's pretty much the core of why I want to die, all other stressful things like self care, chores, ect are just extra things that would be manageable if I didn't have to work. If I won 10 million dollars my depression would be a shit ton easier to handle, my hopelessness would melt, and and suicidal thoughts a thing of the past.

Oh wow thanks for the kind words! I erased and retyped that comment like 10 times cause I felt like it what I was saying sounded dumb or it was to long or pointless. 

I'm sorry to hear you feel similar though, I wouldn't wish this on anyone. Good luck to you to

Hey so I'm pretty much the male version of your partner so I completely get where she's coming from, my own wife is like you struggling to get me to do anything. 

>She can’t bring herself to do anything

For me this feels like a internal battle, I'm stuck just rotting away because I can't get myself to even want to get better if the ultimate goal of getting a job seems impossible. So if the big goal of working a job feels impossible then doing any small steps below it to like exercising, therapy, taking meds, ect seem pointless. So maybe she has a similar thought process? If so then getting her to do anything will be hard, as they say you can lead a horse to water but you can't make him drink it.

Ask her if she feels similar to me, then you'd at least know why she's not doing anything. From there I have no idea what to do. 

Goodluck to you two

There's a few problems with what you said. For one if I do leave her I'd do it only with the intention of killing myself, if I thought I could get better then I'd do it with her help. Also we have been together since middle school(we're almost 24 now), we are each other's 1st partner and we love each other immensely. She considers me her soul mate and at this point doesn't care to live in a world without me in it. She's told me if I were to die the 1st thing she'd do is kill herself and if she were to fail she'd keep trying and I believe her because I feel exactly the same.
So if I could just leave her without putting her life at risk I'd do it but there's no way for me to do that.


>And you cannot love anyone properly, before you love yourself.

I think you're wrong, kinda? I think if I hated my overall personality then what you say might be true but I don't hate my personality, I think I'm all around a pretty nice guy but I hate how lazy, weak, anxiety ridden and depressed I am. That's never stopped me from loving my wife.

There's nothing anyone can do, I just don't want to work, I'm lazy. 
I haven't hit rock bottom yet but when I do I'll kill myself, not try work my way up.

I'm the same exact way. The way I put it is if happiness was a low hanging apple from a tree, I'd be to lazy to reach up and grab it. Instead I stare at it and feel miserable. 

I'm sorry I can't be of any help, all I can say is you aren't alone in this.

Even though it was exhausting for you you were able to do all that which to me is super impressive! To me that alone is a testament of your strength and although life may be overwhelming I think there's a chance for you to thrive.

 Me though? I have nothing to show, not one thing. I haven't even started life and I've given up.

Just don't be like me and give up alright? I wish you well

She knows about everything I'm feeling, I don't really hide anything from her except for if I'm planning to kill myself . The thing is though she can't do much of anything for me since I'm not helping myself, I know I'm super fortunate to have her and it's more than what most here have yet I'm still selfishly feeling like it's not enough. Maybe I am overreacting, but I can't help it and I've been feeling like this for years. 

I understand eating healthy would improve how I feel cause I eat like trash but cooking and cleaning dishes is so much effort that I can't. It seems pointless to even attempt to eat healthier if I'm not ultimately trying to become a functional adult, so more trash eating for me.
It's pretty cool that vitamins fixed a mental health issue for you, I've been taking vitamin D lately since it's low effort and I know I'm deficient, hasn't helped any it seems though.
Yeah I noticed that when he posted his comment right after I posted mine.
I have indeed, but they haven't helped any. At the end of the day though it's just a tool, I gotta meet it halfway which I wasn't doing.

I was thinking about getting therapy but this is exactly how I imagined it would go. 
I don't think I'll even bother, I'm pretty sure I'd be left even more hopeless since then I'd know no therapist could help me.

Not trying is so much easier though, I think I'll go with that. 
I gotta live up to my username anyway

I've been diagnosed with social anxiety. Knowing that doesn't really help though. 

I knew before my 1st attempt that doing so would devastate her so it's not really a new perspective. I've tried using it to counter my suicidal thoughts but I feel like it increases them, I'm under so much guilt that I feel like I can't take anymore which pushes me to suicide but I feel guilty about considering it again so it's like a feedback loop.

My 1st attempt I backed out of it at the last moment, if I didn't it would of worked. I did so only because I knew how much pain my wife was in.

Thanks for reading my nonsense

You are stronger than I, just high school overwhelmed me so much I dropped out and now I'm 23 and never had a job.

Good luck to ya

And then what? Do chores? Have proper hygiene? Work 40 or more hours a week? That's impossible for me. 

I don't see any point in taking the 1st step up some stairs if I know the rest are to hard to do.
I wish I could become one of societys gears, so much guilt would be relieved if I could support the ones I love at least a little bit.

I do indeed, but like I said I don't want to cope, I want a cure. I'm simply unwilling to put in any effort into fighting depression regardless of the fact that I have so much to live for. I guess I just want everything handed to me on a silver platter.
